# Churn early-warning model

*Client industry: e-commerce | Completed: 2022-09-24 | Evidence id: ai_ml:case:p02*

## The problem
The client was a subscription box losing customers silently.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python scripts, XGBoost, standard classical ML pipelines, dataframe-based data wrangling, experiment tracking and a model registry. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project flagged 71% of churners two weeks early at 40% precision.
